text:
Type: large shaggy area rug
Use: soft base under a sofa, coffee table or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: long dense synthetic shag pile
Colors: dark charcoal grey with a slight green-grey cast
Shape: plain rectangle with thick fluffy shag, soft edges, solid color, plush and heavy-looking
Feel: cozy, soft, grounding
Goes with: light grey or white sofas, pale wood, chrome or black accents; modern, minimalist or Scandinavian living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: GSER
product.description: The high pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
